notes: LCC 天穹 ('heavenly vault') absorbs both H7549 (raqia/firmament) and H8064 (shamayim/heavens) — UNV splits these across 天+空
LCC 發光之體 ('light-bodies') explicitly translates מאורות vs UNV's simpler 發光 — single SN H3974 covers the whole compound
LCC 來 serves as purpose marker paralleling Hebrew ל prefix (WAH09001) on להאיר; 照 carries the core H0215
LCC omits UNV's 事 before 就這樣成了 — H1961 attached to 成了 as the main verbal element
UNV+SN tags in the input appear to have been stripped by rendering — reconstruction based on Hebrew source text and standard FHL encoding patterns
Prefix markers (WAH09001 for ל, WAH09002 for ב) placement follows the pattern of attaching to the Chinese word corresponding to the Hebrew prefix function
